notes: Pricing supplement under the ADB GMTN Prospectus of 9 December 2020. The day count is defined only in the pricing supplement (term 16(x), page 6): for a period of less than one full year, other than a Fixed Coupon Amount, interest is actual days over a 365-day year ('Actual/Actual Canadian Compound Method'); full semi-annual periods pay the Fixed Coupon Amount of CAD 13.00 per Specified Denomination. The base prospectus has no Canadian day count. Rounding is stated in term 16(i) (page 5): interest amount per Specified Denomination rounded to two decimal places with CAD 0.005 rounded upwards. Interest Payment Dates are adjusted under the Following Business Day Convention while Interest Period End Dates are 'Unadjusted' (term 16(ii)-(v), page 5), so accrual is unadjusted. Business day: Relevant Financial Center Toronto and Additional Business Centers London and New York (page 6); 'Relevant Business Day' is defined on adb-gmtn-2020 pages 37-38. Form is Registered Notes, a Registered Global Note cleared through CDS (pages 7-8); the record date comes from Condition 7(c)(i) (adb-gmtn-2020 page 42). Interest Commencement Date is 'Not applicable (if different from the Issue Date)', so it equals the Issue Date; the first period 20 October 2025 to 20 April 2026 is a regular period. Final Redemption Amount is 'Aggregate Nominal Amount' with Redemption at par, i.e. 100 per cent. ADB conditions have no Calculation Amount concept.
